html_content:
About West Island Music School

Our passion for music education drives everything we do

Our Story

Founded over 15 years ago, West Island Music School began with a simple vision: to create a welcoming space where students of all ages could discover and develop their musical talents. What started as a small studio has grown into one of the West Island's most respected music schools, serving hundreds of families across Pointe-Claire, Dorval, Dollard-des-Ormeaux, Kirkland, Beaconsfield, and Pierrefonds.

Over the years, our students have gone on to perform at prestigious events, earn music scholarships, and most importantly, develop a lifelong love of music. We take pride in every student's journey, whether they aspire to be professional musicians or simply want to enjoy the enrichment that music brings to life.

Our Mission

To provide exceptional music education in a nurturing and inspiring environment, empowering students of all ages and skill levels to achieve their musical potential and develop a lifelong appreciation for the arts.

Our Values

  • Excellence — We maintain the highest standards in music education, continuously improving our curriculum and teaching methods.
  • Inclusivity — Music is for everyone. We welcome students of all ages, backgrounds, and skill levels.
  • Creativity — We encourage creative expression and help students find their unique musical voice.
  • Community — We foster a supportive community where students, parents, and teachers collaborate and celebrate music together.

Our Facilities

Our modern, purpose-built facility features soundproofed practice rooms, a recital hall, and a comfortable waiting area for parents. Each room is equipped with professional-grade instruments and the latest teaching technology to ensure the best possible learning experience.

  • Soundproofed practice rooms
  • Recital hall for performances
  • Professional-grade instruments
  • Comfortable parent waiting area
  • Free parking
  • Accessible facility

Come Visit Us

We would love to show you around our facility and discuss how we can help you or your child begin their musical journey.
